title: Windwalker Monk — how a Gladiator bursts
summary: A 6x Gladiator Windwalker in 7 Gladiator-level games: Leg Sweep, Badge and Zenith together, then Strike of the Windlord and Fists of Fury.

evidence.note: 26 Sep 2026 · one player (6x Gladiator) in Walking Dead · every player a Gladiator

sections.title: Spinning Crane Kick and Rising Sun Kick are the damage
sections.body: Spinning Crane Kick did 17% of his damage, Rising Sun Kick 14%, Fists of Fury 12%, Blackout Kick 9%, Tiger Palm 8.5% and Rushing Wind Kick 8%. Tiger Palm was his most-pressed button at 6.4 a minute. Touch of Death's 5% is finishes, not burst. PvP talents: Turbo Fists and Wind Waker in all 7 games. One player's play across 10.5 minutes of arena: a proposal to correct.

steps.note: Before Leg Sweep 6 times, about 2s earlier.
18 in 7 games, one about every 35s of arena.
Often the first press into Zenith. 6% of damage.
Within 5s of Zenith, 9 of 18 times. 12% of damage.
The finish at 3-9% health. Not burst.
Often straight into Zenith. 14% of damage.

sections.title: Burst: the kick on their healer

steps.note: 0.4 a minute here. Both kicks in a killing peak were the DK's Mind Freeze.

sections.title: Land the burst on their healer's CC
sections.body: The Monk and DK usually burst together. It killed when their healer was locked out or kicked during those 6 seconds (3 of 5 at this level) and rarely when their healer was free (1 of 7). The damage and the lockout were both there, and mostly not at the same time. The full comp read is in the Walking Dead guide.
